widgets_values: @Image1 is the character - keep its green mottled skin, glowing orange visor bar, grey dreadlocks, beard and long grey coat, cannon over its shoulder. @Image2 is the location AND the opening frame - the first frame of the video must match @Image2 exactly: the same canyon walls, fog bank, glowing green valley floor, gravel ridge and parked rover, seen from outside the canyon. One continuous shot, 5 seconds, no cuts. 0-1s: hold @Image2 for a beat, then the camera dives in fast and smooth, skimming low over the gravel and into the canyon mouth, the rover sliding past out of focus at the edge of frame. 1-2.5s: deep inside, the fog thickens to a grey wall; two small points of orange light appear in it and pulse - the visor bar and the muzzle of the cannon on the character's shoulder - while a vague tall silhouette forms behind them, boots crunching closer on the gravel. 2.5-4s: the character from @Image1 walks forward out of the fog at ordinary adult size, resolving from silhouette into detail - green skin, dreadlocks, beard, grey coat swinging, the cannon on its shoulder catching the green glow from below. 4-5s: the camera slows and pushes in to a tight close-up of its face as the fog swirls behind it, the orange visor bar bright across its eyes, one slow breath of cold air leaving its mouth; the frame settles and holds on the face. Photoreal, volumetric backlit fog, cool teal with green bounce light from the valley floor, anamorphic flares, shallow depth of field, slight handheld drift. Sound: a sparse low synth drone with a slow heartbeat pulse, a rising riser under the push-in that lands on one soft swell exactly as the camera reaches its face, wind through rock, gravel footsteps and one metallic shift of the cannon underneath. Instrumental only, no vocals, no drums.
